text: Pretty close to what I'm looking for. Free and simple routine tracker. I like that you can make routines but I wish it wasn't largely run on a timer. If you could select and check off the tasks individually instead of the timers being consecutive and for the entire routine. That way a routine could be more personalized because some tasks may not immediately follow another. I might exercise after I make my bed but not immediately after. If it was more of a routine/habit tracker hybrid I'd love it
